name: BIDS Mrtrix3 Connectome
summary: Builds a subject structural connectome from DWI and a T1-weighted image with the MRtrix3_connectome BIDS App (0.2.2), with optional dwipreproc preprocessing and an AAL or FreeSurfer parcellation.
description: Arranges the T1w and one or more DWI runs into a BIDS directory and runs the bids/mrtrix3_connectome participant-level pipeline (MRtrix3 tractography and connectome construction) with the chosen parcellation and streamline count. Use it to obtain a tractography-based connectome from raw or preprocessed DWI in one step. Running the built-in preprocessing (preprocessed unchecked) needs at least two DWI runs whose metadata include TotalReadoutTime and PhaseEncodingDirection. The whole BIDS App output directory is returned as a raw dataset.

inputs.description: One or more DWI runs (with bvals and bvecs) of the subject; multiple runs become run-01, run-02, ... in the BIDS input.
inputs.requirements: For preprocessing, at least two runs with TotalReadoutTime and PhaseEncodingDirection in the metadata.

inputs.description: T1-weighted anatomical image of the same subject.

outputs.description: The MRtrix3_connectome participant output directory (connectome matrices and intermediate files) for the subject.

parameters.description: The number of streamlines to generate
Uncheck this to run mrtrix3 dwipreproc. To do so, you must have at least 2 DWI inputs and your metadata must contain both TotalReadoutTime and PhaseEncodingDirection.

failure_modes.message: Two DWI images are required to run mrtrix3_connectome preprocessing.
failure_modes.fix: Provide at least two DWI runs, or keep preprocessed checked.

failure_modes.message: TotalReadoutTime and PhaseEncodingDirection BIDS fields reqd to run mrtrix3_connectome preproc.
failure_modes.fix: Add TotalReadoutTime and PhaseEncodingDirection to the DWI metadata, or keep preprocessed checked.
